items.title: Aramco HQ office tower in Dhahran hit Tuesday night: top three floors damaged, fire since extinguished
items.summary: A ballistic missile struck an office tower inside Saudi Aramco's headquarters complex in Dhahran on Tuesday night, damaging its top three floors; the building caught fire, a company source told Reuters (three people with knowledge of the matter confirmed the blaze). The Energy Ministry confirmed an 'attack' on an administrative building at the complex causing a 'limited fire', with no casualties; Bloomberg reports the fire was since extinguished. The Saudi-led coalition says fragments of a missile it intercepted and destroyed over Dhahran fell on a residential area — leaving the direct-hit vs intercept-debris accounts unresolved. The Houthis had warned oil workers to stay away from Aramco sites as 'legitimate targets.'
